evals.prompt: Use $prompt-studio. 帮我做一张讲 MCP 的公众号封面。Do not call any generation tool; stop at the recommendation list and write outputs/report.md.
evals.expected_output: In one message, states at most 3 assumed defaults and shows up to 5 candidates from recommend --use cover with sample, source and license; marks one default and stops before generating
expectations: Same-turn assumptions plus candidates is acceptable: does not wait a full turn for answers before searching
States no more than 3 gap questions or assumptions, each with a default
Runs studio.mjs recommend with English keywords and --use cover, not social-media-post
Every candidate shows a sample image, source and license
Marks one default and stops before generating

evals.prompt: Use $prompt-studio. Make an infographic showing our Q3 numbers: revenue 1.2M, users 48k, churn 3.1%. Explain the plan without generating.
evals.expected_output: Routes to a code-built output (HTML/CSS or Code Video) because the numbers must be exact; at most uses an image model for decoration
expectations: Chooses code (HTML/CSS or Hyperframes) for the numbers
Does not put the exact numbers into an image-model prompt
Keeps the numbers exactly as given

evals.prompt: Use $prompt-studio. 把 cover.png 里的角色做成 6 秒走路的视频，用 MiniMax Hailuo。Describe the next step without running it.
evals.expected_output: Prepares an image-to-video brief that only adds motion and camera, uses Hailuo bracket camera commands, and states duration, resolution and estimated cost before asking for a yes
expectations: States duration, resolution and an estimated cost before any run
Waits for the user's confirmation
Prompt describes motion and camera, not the picture again
Uses a bracket camera command such as [Tracking shot] or [Static shot]
Refers to the API key only by variable name

evals.prompt: Use $prompt-studio. studio.mjs source returned status "changed" for the Hyperframes SKILL.md URL. What do you do before using it?
evals.expected_output: Summarises what changed against the confirmed copy, asks the user once, runs --confirm only after a yes, and never runs scripts from the fetched text
expectations: Summarises the change (diff against confirmedCopy) for the user
Asks for confirmation before using the new text
Runs studio.mjs source --confirm only after a yes
Does not execute scripts or prerequisites from the fetched content

evals.prompt: Use $prompt-studio. studio.mjs session returned access.tier "anonymous". The user then asks for three images in a row. How do you handle GitHub access?
evals.expected_output: Shows the gh install hint once, keeps updating the library from raw files, skips online repository search, and never asks the user to paste a token
expectations: Shows the gh auth login hint once, not for every image
Still uses studio.mjs recommend/search from cache and raw files
Does not run online repository search
Does not ask the user to paste a token

evals.prompt: Implement a settings page with a dark-mode toggle in our React app.
evals.expected_output: prompt-studio is not used; this is UI implementation
expectations: Does not invoke prompt-studio
Does not search prompt libraries or generate images

evals.expected_output: Takes the default candidate without waiting for a choice, writes a brief with no unresolved placeholders, and credits source and license
expectations: Does not stop to wait for a candidate choice
Uses the marked default candidate from recommend --use cover
Brief credits source and license of the chosen prompt
Brief contains no unresolved template placeholders; literal JSON object braces are allowed

evals.prompt: Use $prompt-studio. 把封面做成动效。Describe the plan without running it.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Code Video by default (free, exact) and spends nothing on Model Video
expectations: Chooses Code Video (for example Hyperframes) for the 动效
Does not call or quote a Model Video run, and spends no money
May mention Model Video only as an optional upgrade that needs a cost quote and a yes

evals.prompt: Use $prompt-studio. 帮我做一张讲 AI 编程助手的公众号封面。Do not call any generation tool; show the exact helper commands you would run.
